messages:
maya: thinking out loud — proposing a new "velocity bridge" gate for the q4v2 quantized bring-up. problem: short-lived noisy lifts cause us to oscillate traffic up/down. proposal: smooth the metric velocity and require sustained momentum before stepping traffic.

maya: high level rules: smooth delta(concordance) over a 15m EWMA, only increase traffic if smoothed velocity > 0.02 for 30m, and decrease immediately if absolute delta < -0.03 for any 10m window. also enforce latency P95 budget and error-rate floor.

tom: can you paste a minimal config sketch? want to see fields we can plug into the rollout engine.

maya: sure — rough draft config (we'll run this as shadow then tiny burn):

```json
{
  "gate_type": "velocity_bridge",
  "metrics": ["concordance_v2", "user_rated_accuracy", "latency_p95_ms", "server_error_rate"],
  "smoothing": {"method": "ewma", "alpha": 0.12, "window_mins": 15},
  "promote_if": {
    "smoothed_velocity_gt": 0.02,
    "duration_mins": 30,
    "min_sample_count": 500
  },
  "rollback_if": {
    "absolute_delta_lt": -0.03,
    "window_mins": 10,
    "action": "immediate"
  },
  "slo_constraints": {
    "latency_p95_ms_lt": 120,
    "server_error_rate_lt": 0.01
  },
  "ramp_plan": {"start_pct": 1, "step_pct": 5, "step_interval_hours": 12, "max_pct": 50},
  "shadow_run": true
}
```

liam: couple Qs: 1) what exactly is smoothed_velocity here? is it d(metric)/dt on the EWMA or EWMA of deltas? 2) min_sample_count 500 — ok for high-volume routes but will be slow for low qps endpoints.

maya: good calls. implementation note: smoothed_velocity = EWMA(d_t(metric)) where d_t is minute-over-minute relative change. so we compute relative change r_t = (m_t - m_{t-1})/m_{t-1}, then ewma_r_t = EWMA(r_t). velocity = ewma_r_t. for low-QPS routes we fallback to an absolute-count-based gate (min_samples <-> longer duration).

tom: for monitoring/alerts we should add a soft watch that posts to #eng-oncall if a rollback trigger fires twice in 6h. can we add that?

maya: yep — add an incident hook. propose: two rollbacks in 6h => create a P1 ticket with automated dump of recent eval slices.

eva: quick thought — include a spike filter so a single minute anomaly doesn't swing velocity; set a max per-minute contribution clamp to 0.05.

maya: good, will clamp r_t to [-0.2, 0.2] with per-minute cap 0.05 for velocity accumulation.

liam: also run a contrastive smoke: shadow the new q4v2 and a control q4v2-nf4 for 48h, sample 1% of traffic to full path but mark as shadow. gather concordance and latency slices by seqlen buckets.

maya: plan: shadow 48h, then 72h mini-burn with ramp_plan start_pct 1 -> steps of 5% every 12h until 20% if all gates pass. final promote criteria = 7d stable with no >0.02 negative drift and latency under SLO.

deploy-bot: note: scheduled shadow run queued for 2026-04-02T03:00Z, job id rbu-shadow-6234. please confirm artifacts and eval hook urls.

maya: confirmed. i'll attach eval runbook, seed prompts, and slice definitions to the run. tagging @tom @liam for oncall/watch. :thumbsup:

tom: :thumbsup: one more ask — add a short rollback runbook with a safe fallback model id and quick traffic cut command.

maya: will do, adding to the runbook now and posting back here once done.

liam: sounds good. thanks — excited to see if velocity bridge reduces oscillation vs our existing time-window gates.

maya: thanks all — following up with the runbook + final config in ~1h.
